leagues.name: English Premier League
leagues.positionRule: Final league-table position (points, then goal difference).

leagues.name: La Liga (Spain)
leagues.positionRule: Final league-table position (points; ties by head-to-head — approximated here by goal difference).

leagues.name: Bundesliga (Germany)
leagues.positionRule: Final league-table position (points, then goal difference). 16th enters a relegation play-off.

leagues.name: Ligue 1 (France)
leagues.positionRule: Final league-table position. League shrank from 20 to 18 clubs in 2023-24.

leagues.name: NBA
leagues.positionRule: Regular-season seed within conference (by W-L record, ties by point differential).

leagues.name: MLB
leagues.positionRule: Rank within league (AL/NL) by win-loss record (162-game season).

leagues.name: AFL
leagues.positionRule: Final home-and-away ladder position (premiership points, then percentage).

leagues.name: NRL
leagues.positionRule: Final regular-season ladder position (competition points, then differential).

leagues.name: F1 Constructors
leagues.positionRule: Final Constructors' Championship position (season points, incl. sprints).
